Strategy: Reward bins whose post-placement leftover is a multiple of ten, encouraging round leftover sizes on top of Best Fit tightness. It may help if round leftovers tile better, but may fail if residuals land on multiples of ten only by chance.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if (r - item) % 10 == 0 else 0) for r in bins]
```
